description: rnews_main.rs:322-329 — The only end-of-run summary (accepted/rejected/transient counts) is emitted at tracing::info!. If the operator configures log.level = 'warn' (common in production to reduce noise), or sets RUST_LOG=warn, the batch completes with zero visible output — no confirmation the batch ran, no counts. At 3am this looks identical to a hung or killed process. Better approach: emit the summary unconditionally to stderr via eprintln! in addition to (or instead of) tracing::info!, or use tracing::warn! when transient > 0 or rejected > 0 so abnormal outcomes are always visible.
title: batch summary only at INFO level — invisible at warn/error
